title: Lost context.Context
description: A request-scoped context is replaced before a downstream call.

candidates.title: Cancellation and deadlines are discarded

evidence.execution_path: A cancelled request enters Load, which constructs a live background context for Store.Load
evidence.violated_invariant: Request cancellation and deadline must propagate to blocking downstream work
evidence.falsifier_checked: Verified Store.Load receives no other cancellation channel or deadline

candidates.impact: Downstream work can continue after the request ends and consume resources indefinitely.
candidates.recommendation: Pass the received ctx to Store.Load.

verdicts.reason: The replacement with context.Background is explicit on the only downstream path.
